description: Filter the live LucyESL board of English-teaching jobs in South Korea: region, student age, housing, visa, schedule, contract, setting, direct hire, minimum salary, free text. Returns the number that match and a page of structured records; pay in KRW per month unless stated otherwise; null means the advert did not say.

age.description: Student age group; adults_only means adults and nobody younger

contract.description: An employment contract (employee) or a contractor agreement

direct_only.description: Only employers hiring directly (no recruiters or agencies)

format.description: Class shape: group, small group (up to 4) or one to one

housing.description: Housing provided, an allowance instead, or none

limit.description: Records per page: 25 by default, at most 50

min_salary.description: Minimum monthly pay in KRW; snaps down to the board's steps 2000000, 2300000, 2600000, 3000000

q.description: Words to match in the title, city or employer name

region.description: Region of South Korea (gyeonggi includes Incheon)

setting.description: Where the teaching happens: the academy, a company, a school or a student's home

specialty.description: What is taught besides general English, such as IELTS, business English or phonics

visa.description: e2 = E-2 sponsorship, f = F-series visa holders

name: search_jobs
title: Filter the live board
